scope: Documentary provenance, qualified dates and uses, model/guide focus and floor agreement, separate arch identities, and limits of collection/repair representation. Bibliographic metadata and original explanatory copy are excluded from fact/timeline summary counts. Geometry, rendering, physical accessibility and present maintenance condition are outside this audit.
